text: Optum is one of UnitedHealth Group's two distinct and complementary businesses, alongside UnitedHealthcare.
short: Optum is one of UnitedHealth Group's two businesses.

source.name: UnitedHealth Group: Our businesses
source.quote: UnitedHealth Group is a healthcare and well-being company with team members in two distinct and complementary businesses — Optum and UnitedHealthcare — working to help build a modern, high-performing health system.
